Priya Patel: Quick async check — wrapping up micropulse sample app patch for the Python quickstart. Done: replaced bare `requests` example with the SDK client, added retry examples, and clarified env var section. Blocker: Windows CI failing on the wheel build step (looks like a path separator issue). Today: pushing a fix to the CI matrix and a tiny README tweak. @Sam Chen can you glance at README diff when available? Also @Jordan Lee any guidance on canonical SDK retry idioms?

Sam Chen: Yep, I can review. FYI I hit the same wheel flake yesterday — guessing pathlib vs os.path.join in tests. If you paste the failing output I can propose a small patch.

Priya Patel: paste failing log:```
ERROR: tests/test_quickstart.py::test_build_wheel
FileNotFoundError: [Errno 2] No such file or directory: 'dist\\micropulse-0.1-py3-none-any.whl'
```

Jordan Lee: That path error screams Windows path separators. The test constructs the wheel path with `os.path.join('dist', wheel_name)` but somewhere a manual string concat uses forward slashes. Recommend switching tests to pathlib.Path and using `.as_posix()` only when comparing to strings, or normalize with `str(pathlib.Path(...))`. Changing the test to use pathlib will be the least surprising.

Sam Chen: I can open a tiny PR to change the test to pathlib and add an explicit Windows job if we need it in the CI matrix. Priya — if you push your README change now I can attach the test patch to the same branch.

Priya Patel: pushed README change to branch `micropulse/sample-fix` — PR #482. Also added quickstart snippet showing pip install from our index and a minimal example:```
from redwood_inference import Client
import os

client = Client(api_key=os.environ.get("REDWOOD_API_KEY"))
resp = client.generate("Hello from quickstart", model="redwood-1-small")
print(resp.text)
```
Link to PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/micropulse/pull/482

devex-bot: CI rerun queued for PR #482 — windows job scheduled (workflow: windows-tests.yml).

Sam Chen: Reviewing now. Small nits: missing `import os` in the original snippet (looks fixed), and prefer `Client(...).generate(...).text` usage as you have. One suggestion: include a one-line note about the `REDWOOD_API_KEY` env var location (Console -> API keys). I'll push those tiny edits to your branch. :thumbsup:

Priya Patel: thanks! No other blockers from my side. Today: merge after green CI and cut a short docs release note. Will ping here if CI still flakes or if QA finds anything. :raised_hands:
